name: AAJ Electronics Inc.
old_description: "Tailored solutions for every business type, backed by industry-leading technology and support"
about:
AAJ Electronics Inc. is based in Smithfield, Rhode Island. Founded in 2002, the company began as an electronics sales and repair business before evolving into a full-service point-of-sale (POS) partner for retail and hospitality merchants. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides POS systems, payment processing, and related technology services. It resells and implements several POS platforms—including PC America CRE for Windows-based retail, NRS for cloud-connected convenience stores, Genius Retail for Android-based retail, and Genius Restaurant for full-service and quick-service dining. Beyond software, AAJ Electronics offers implementation, staff training, 24/7 remote support, and ongoing system tuning. Services extend to online ordering integration, self-service kiosks, loyalty and gift-card programs, inventory management via handheld devices, lottery tracking, label and barcode printing, digital menu boards, AI-powered invoice automation, and multi-location management. The firm acts as a dealer for payment processors Global Payments, Fiserv, and TSYS.

AAJ Electronics serves retail segments such as liquor stores, convenience stores, smoke and tobacco shops, grocery and meat markets, apparel and specialty retailers, and food trucks. In hospitality, its clients include fine-dining restaurants, quick-service restaurants (QSR), pizzerias, cafés and bakeries, bars and nightlife venues, and food trucks. The company targets single-location and multi-location operators needing integrated sales, inventory, and payment workflows.

The company emphasizes matching technology to each merchant’s workflow rather than pushing a single platform, citing over 20 years of POS experience and U.S.-based onboarding and support as differentiators.

name: ABB
old_description: Global manufacturer of switchgear, circuit breakers, transformers, and electric motors.
about:
ABB is headquartered in Cary, North Carolina. The company was founded in 1988.

ABB manufactures switchgear, circuit breakers, transformers, and electric motors, and provides electrification, automation, robotics, and digital solutions. Its portfolio includes the SACE Emax 3 air circuit breaker, the GoFa collaborative robot with ultra-accuracy, Azipod electric propulsion systems, and the ABB Ability Digital Powertrain for remote asset monitoring. The company operates across electrification, automation, motion, robotics, and power conversion, delivering products ranging from medium-voltage switchgear to industrial IoT and AI suites.

Customers span buildings and construction, data centers, food and beverage, marine shipping, oil and gas, and power generation utilities. ABB notes that one in four data centers worldwide run on its technology, and its solutions are used to decarbonize shipping and optimize energy infrastructure. Its automation business offers industry-specific integrated automation, control technologies, software, and advanced services.

ABB positions itself as a global technology leader in electrification and automation, aiming to help industries become more productive, efficient, and sustainable so they can 'outrun' competitors. The company emphasizes connecting engineering and digitalization expertise to accelerate decarbonization and increase energy efficiency.

name: ABCO Automation Inc
old_description: With 47 years of experience in automation, ABCO has been at the forefront of the manufacturing industry since 1977.
about:
ABCO Automation Inc. was founded in 1977 by Graham Ricks in Browns Summit, North Carolina. The company began by providing electrical control systems and custom packaging equipment to Coca-Cola, and early innovations in labeling and filling led to significant growth throughout the 1980s. In the mid-1990s, ABCO transitioned to an employee-owned ESOP structure, a model the leadership credits for a highly motivated workforce.

Today, ABCO operates two facilities in Browns Summit: a Design Build Complex and a Contract Manufacturing & Assembly Center. The company delivers custom automation solutions through four core service lines: Design Build, Build to Print, Contract Manufacturing, and Robot Automation. Its engineering and manufacturing capabilities span mechanical and electrical design, fabrication, welding, assembly, kitting, inspection, laser marking, machining, machine tending, dispensing, and material handling integration. The firm serves clients ranging from Fortune 500 corporations to start-ups.

ABCO's industry focus includes food and beverage, logistics, life sciences, AgriTech, and healthcare. Long-standing relationships with major food and beverage brands such as Coca-Cola illustrate its experience with filling systems, packaging, and palletizing. The company also supports logistics automation with robotic palletizing, case packing, and conveyor systems, and provides precision automation for life sciences and medical device manufacturing.

The company emphasizes a single-source, turnkey approach backed by decades of mechanical and electrical engineering expertise. Its stated mission is to provide a single source for innovative automation services and manufacturing support that contribute to client success, guided by core values that prioritize client needs, integrity, excellence, and teamwork.

name: ABX Innovative Packaging Solutions
old_description: We’re interested in what you have to say. Reach out to learn how we can help
about:
ABX Innovative Packaging Solutions is a flexible packaging manufacturer headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, with manufacturing facilities across the United States including sites in Rhinelander, Wisconsin; Columbus, Georgia; Homer, Louisiana; Macedon, New York; Milwaukee and Pewaukee, Wisconsin; and Schaumburg, Illinois. The company operates nine facilities and employs approximately nine hundred people.

The company produces flexible packaging through a fully integrated process that spans film extrusion, converting, pouching, bagging, printing, and laminating. Its extrusion lines produce coextruded cast and blown films up to 11 layers with thickness capabilities from 1 to 13 mil, using specialty resin blends such as nylon, polypropylene, EVOH, ionomers, and metallocene. Converting operations include stand‑up pouches, rollstock, and a fleet of more than 45 bag machines, while printing is handled on wide‑web W&H flexographic presses with AVT registration. In‑house design consulting, structural testing, and analytical labs support development from concept to commercialization.

ABX serves customers in consumer, healthcare, industrial, and specialty markets, with specific applications in food, personal care, and medical packaging. Its client base includes brands seeking high‑barrier, breathable, or sustainable film structures for products ranging from individual portions to large‑format industrial bags.

The company emphasizes a one‑stop‑shop model from resin to finished package, backed by third‑party quality audits and certifications. It highlights its status as the first plant to earn FTA FIRST certification for wide‑web printers, along with ISO 9001:2015, AIB Superior Rating, HACCP procedures, and FDA‑approved materials as differentiators that support safety, consistency, and regulatory compliance.

name: ACP Sheet Metal Co Inc.
old_description: …sheet metal done right… helping you keep your cool (or make you hot)
about:
ACP Sheet Metal Co. Inc. operates from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, where it was founded in 1977 by Harold Dills. The company serves the western two-thirds of the state from its facility on North Garnett Drive.

The firm fabricates and installs HVAC duct systems, including rectangular, square, round, and oval spiral ductwork, along with associated equipment and accessories. Its drafting department produces 2D and 3D shop drawings using AutoDesk, Trimble, NavisWorks, and Revit, enabling Building Information Modeling coordination to detect conflicts before installation. An industrial group designs, fabricates, and installs handrails, guardrails, stairs, platforms, catwalks, and conveyor systems, working with stainless steel, aluminum, black iron (both cold-rolled and hot-rolled), and galvanized steel. The company also provides estimating, project management, and full installation services.

ACP serves healthcare, education, institutional, military, and private-sector clients. Its industrial work spans pet care and pet food (over 40 years), food and beverage, oil and gas, mining, manufacturing, office and professional buildings, restaurants, hospitality, and the cannabis/CBD industry.

The company emphasizes BIM-based conflict detection, quick-turn estimating with detailed scopes, and design-build or design-assist project delivery to keep projects on schedule and budget.

name: ADAR Technologies
old_description: Our advanced technology transforms waste into opportunity—dry, pulverize, and sanitize with zero emissions.
about:
ADAR Technologies is headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona. The company was formed in 2025 by CEO Dan Kelly, COO Doug Farrington, and Technology Advisor Arie Bos, following three years of development that began in 2022 with a prototype in the Netherlands. The founders set out to solve the problem of wet organic materials — manure, sludge, surplus produce — that were too costly to dry conventionally and too valuable to discard.

ADAR’s core technology, called ADS, dries, pulverizes, and sanitizes waste in a single pass without fossil fuels, added heat, or harmful chemicals. The process yields a dry, odorless, pathogen-free powder that retains the full nutritional profile of the source material. The company commercializes this output in two ways: it sells spec‑consistent powder ingredients — high‑protein supplements from seaweed and seafood waste, zeolite powder, and nutrient‑rich fertilizer from manure — directly to formulators and blenders in the feed, pet food, fertilizer, fuel, and mineral markets; and through ADAR Environmental Services it assumes waste streams from generators at roughly half their current disposal cost, turning liability into feedstock.

Primary customers include animal‑nutrition formulators, pet‑food manufacturers, fertilizer blenders, and industrial mineral processors. A global agricultural company has already endorsed the technology for converting sargassum seaweed and seafood waste into high‑protein livestock feed. Municipal sewage, agricultural by‑products, and wood‑chip waste are also cited as feedstocks.

The company’s differentiation rests on three claims: zero‑emission processing, 100 % nutrient retention, and a business model that cuts waste‑disposal costs by 50 % while creating salable ingredients. The founders state that no thermal process has previously achieved a shelf‑stable, pathogen‑free powder with complete nutrient integrity.

name: AES FOODS
old_description: worked hard since 2007 to bring you the best Farmers Choice Sausages with a distinctive taste.  We now have Paddy’s Farmers Choice sausages in
about:
AES Foods operates from Newark, Delaware, and has been active since 2007. The company describes itself as a distributor and retailer of fine meats and products, with a focus on bringing Farmers Choice Sausages to the U.S. market. Ownership details and founders are not disclosed.

The product catalog centers on African and Kenyan food items. AES Foods imports and sells Paddy's Farmers Choice Sausages in pork, beef, and chicken varieties, alongside Kenyan black teas, green teas, herbal teas, flavored teas, and coffee. The range extends to spices, herbs, seasonings, tomato and hot sauces, jams, margarine, non-GMO white cornmeal (Ugali Poa), wheat flour, beans, grains, lentils, and fresh meats including beef, goat, lamb, and seafood. Brands carried include KETEPA teas, Blue Band margarine, and Super Sela Basmati rice.

The company sells directly to consumers through its e-commerce site, offering retail packs and multi-pack promotions. While the primary channel appears to be retail, the breadth of imported products suggests it may also supply ethnic grocery stores, restaurants, or wholesale buyers, though specific customer types are not detailed.

AES Foods emphasizes the distinctive taste of its Farmers Choice Sausages, noting that the products command a slightly higher cost but are "worth every penny." The business was built on the goal of delivering that specific sausage profile to the U.S. market.

old_description: AG Interior Designs crafts high-end custom furniture, drapery, and automated window treatments for luxury homes, hotels/resorts, and commercial spaces. Proudly made in Las Vegas.
about:
AG Interior Designs was founded in 2013 in Las Vegas, Nevada. The company operates two dedicated manufacturing floors in its hometown, producing custom furniture, drapery, and automated window treatments for high-end residential and commercial projects across the western United States.

The shop specializes in handcrafted custom furniture, luxury drapery, motorized window coverings, and reupholstery services. Its output spans complete hardware solutions for window treatments and bespoke furnishings, all fabricated in-house. The facility serves designers and direct clients with projects ranging from single-room residential installations to large-scale hospitality and casino fit-outs.

Primary markets include luxury residential, hospitality (five-star resorts and casinos), and exclusive commercial spaces. The company works with interior designers and high-end clients throughout Nevada, California, Arizona, Utah, and Colorado, delivering made-in-the-USA products for both new construction and renovation.

AG Interior Designs emphasizes custom craftsmanship built to each client's vision, sourcing premium fabrics, woods, and hardware. A stated differentiator is smart-home integration, particularly motorized drapery and automated window coverings, paired with a reputation for meticulous attention to detail across all project phases.

old_description: distributes quality parts all over the world. To find parts in your area of the United States, enter your zip code.
about:
AG Parts Mfg Inc operates from Shelley, Idaho, where it has served the agricultural sector since at least 2010. The company does not publicly disclose its founders or ownership structure, but it presents itself as a dedicated supplier of replacement parts for farming equipment.

The business stocks and distributes a wide range of agricultural components — carrier rollers, flanged rollers, scrapers, shaker rollers, sprockets, standoffs, nose rollers, Flory sweepers, idlers, bushings, and bearings — with 145 active part numbers listed in its online catalog. Beyond distribution, AG Parts offers contract manufacturing services, stating it can find, design, or build custom parts for customers. The company warrants every sintered steel part it sells for one full year.

Primary customers include agricultural equipment dealers across the United States and individual growers who order directly. The company ships worldwide, positioning itself as a single source for both standard and hard-to-find components used in planting, harvesting, and soil-preparation machinery.

AG Parts emphasizes its "QUALITY in Motion" philosophy, highlighting an unconditional one-year warranty on sintered steel parts and a willingness to engineer custom solutions when off-the-shelf items do not meet a grower's needs.
